measurements.evidence_quote: The average zeta potential measurements of the airborne particles collected on the PVC filters for NMAM 500 for all categories of plastic, as well as the control filter, were between approximately -2 and 2 mV, indicating that the particles are neutral. || The zeta potential of particles collected on the PVC filters with NMAM 0500 was measured using a ZetaPALS (Brookhaven Instruments Corporation, Holtsville, NY). The filters were suspended in a solution of purified water and sonicated for 30–60 s in order to release the airborne particles.
